data.title: Y2K
data.tagline: Use glossy digital optimism, bright plastic color, and early-2000s references
data.description: Y2K design draws from the late 1990s and early 2000s: translucent plastic, chrome, bubbles, bright pink and blue, compact gadgets, and optimistic ideas of the digital future. Use specific references and a controlled palette so the result feels intentional rather than a pile of retro effects.

avoid: Cover text with sparkles and translucent decoration
Use low-contrast chrome for functional labels
Mix Y2K with unrelated retro periods
Apply a playful nostalgia theme to a serious operational tool

data.agentPrompt: Y2K social music profile, translucent plastic cards, chrome title, bubblegum pink and ice blue palette, friend profile, now-playing panel and guestbook columns, glossy rounded buttons, restrained star and sparkle accents
